artboards.title: Option C — tables only, empty sections hidden
Carry a whole row into the open file

annotations.text: One change point: refSection in app.js:4835-4849. Table blocks become cards; everything else paints block.html into .ref-prose. A, B and C differ only in what that branch keeps.
B and C compose. B decides what survives inside a section; C decides whether a section left with nothing is drawn at all. B+C is a legitimate pick.

Whole row, not a line: PIC, SP, Status and the rest ride along. That means the target is a table and the columns have to be mapped — the one thing the 2026-09-03 roadmap insert avoided. Still nothing stored outside the markdown, and still nothing summed.
